title: A Hard Day's Work

title: Parasite... Good?
description:
If you're captured by a cage-carrying Wardenfly while cursed, you won't be sent to the usual spot.

Instead, the parasite will lash out, setting Hornet free and killing the would-be kidnapper.

title: Free Quill!
description:
If you avoid purchasing a quill from Shakra, a unique red one can be collected here, near Trobbio's boss room - though defeating him is not a requirement.

Similarly, a unique purple quill can be found here in Act 3.

The quill you collect will determine the icon of the Map & Quill in the inventory screen.

title: Hope for Verdania
description:
Some time after defeating the Clover Dancers, greenery will begin to sprout from their final resting places.

It may take time, but it seems there's hope for the old kingdom yet.
